aiDecision.thesis: An $0.85M PEPE deposit into a $1.55B/day market implies only ~0.26% price impact, well below the ~0.48% minimum edge. The wallet sent 100% of its balance but holds just 0.039% of supply, so this is a small holder exiting, not a treasury or unlock event.
aiDecision.rationale: Size is immaterial relative to PEPE's real liquidity; modeled delta (0.26%) is under the cost floor and the market has already ticked up 2.8%, the opposite direction. Low transaction count EOA fully draining a modest balance looks like ordinary retail/personal exit, not sellable treasury supply. No tradable edge.
